tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1na1)༄༅// byang bdag po'i zla gsang dri lan bzhugs so//

(1ba2)༄༅// bkra shis lha yi ri bo nyams dga' ba// bsod nams stobs rgyas tshangs pa'i mdun sa nas// rnam dpyod klu dbyangs bye ba phrag brgya pa'i// bsil bur 'dar ldan dri tshig bu mo'i mtsho// khyab 'jug rkang par bcos pa'i lus kyis su// mgrin sngon ral pa'i phyogs su mngon par babs// de der thag rings bshad pas ngal ba bzhin// rgyang ring gnyid log de nas rab sad pa// thugs bzhed lbu dkar shel gyi rgyan can 'di'o// pad lugs las gzhan gnubs lugs gang yin zhes/ zla gsang phyogs 'dir khyod thugs dogs de la// lcags sdig chos kyi bka' 'byed lde mig tu// u rgyan pad+mas mdzad pa la// chos mtshan sum cu rtsa brgyad yod// 'khor lo nyi shu rtsa bdun yod// shog ldeb gsum la tshang ba yod// sdig pa'i chos la bsgril tu med// thun mong bsrung mtshams tsam du 'gro// zhes pa sangs rgyas ye shes nyid gsung lags// de bas dang por pad lugs phyi ma la// gnubs lugs zhes su drag sngags mkhas pas bsgrags// pad+mas mi mkhyen gnubs kyis shes smra min// dang por zab sbas phyi mar gsal bstan phyir// lugs phyi lhag par dngos su 'thon min nam// mchod rten srog shing dbyibs mdar gsungs pa la// da lta'i mda' tshad dgos dgongs 'khrul ba 'di// blo ldan khyod thugs rmongs pa mi srid kyang*// gzhan la co 'drir brdzu ba yin nam snyam// srog shing lhag la las gshin gsum dgos pa// rtsa rgyud gzhung gis dngos su ma zin kyang*// dgos don lha thems yi ges bshad pa yin// gyad gnon lta brgyad dkyil 'khor dgod nor lo// 'khrul bsam mi 'tshal lcags sdig 'di nyid kyi// sgrub thabs snying gzer nag por 'di skad gsungs// lho na gshin rje nag po ni// 'khor lo tsit+ta'i 'phreng ba bsnams// zhes sogs (2na3)nyid dang mchod rten sgron rgyas par// dbus su phyag rgya zil gnon bskyad// shar thugs lho sku nub tu sbal// byang du ka ru mtshams gyad gnon/

zla gam sprul pa gsum po la/ zhes pas gzhung nyid gzigs pas gsal bar mchis/ dpe na mi snang khyod gsung thos lo la/ thod sku thod tshal gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs yin/ tshe bdag gzhung las de 'dra bshad pa med/ 'di ci rgyas 'debs gar yin sgrub thabs su/ thod sbyor 'bru sna sman gyis bkang*/ zhes gsungs/ de yi zhal bzhes nang de na/ pho thod ma thod bzang po la/ lha bzo stobs ldan mkhas pa yis// rgyal nas gzung ste yab yum sku// sras mchog yab yum mkha' lding bzhi// zhes gsungs nyes par btags te skyon med do// a+ye ring bar gyi 'bru gsum mi 'thad lo// snying gzer ur mo las bzhi rnal bzla la/ 'bru gsum btsug wa brgya dang zhe dgu pa/ phyi ni mchod rten la brten sum sbral gyi// a+yai ring bsrung bar bgrang la bshad pa yin// spyi sde ba bcu gnyis la sogs skabs kyis shes/ sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyang mtha' gcig min// dper brjod drug po sngags byang bu yig tu// bcu gnyis pa dang 'bru brgyad gsungs// bcu gnyis slad du bgrang ba ni/ gtso 'khor tha dad bsnyen dang bzla tshul lung*// gtso bo brgya la 'khor la bdun// zhes pa snying gzer du byung mchod sgron du// gtso la khri la yum la stong*// 'khor la brgya yis 'dzab dgongs rdzogs// so sor bsnyen pa'i dus su ni// sgrol yum thugs ka'i dzaḥlas ni// rkang byed snying gzer lung yin des bshad do// rnal bzlog dkrug dang bzla ba'i tshul sogs la/ zhi drag khyad par bgrang yas mchis pa ni// mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal skyin myangs pa na// spyi rgyud mang yang 'dir ni snying 'dzings nyid// rgyud gzhung rtogs dka' rig 'dzin che gzhung bsnyen// de bas bdag tshig bdag dang skyon rtogs mkhan// zla ba rab rib mig can lta bur mtshungs// zla gsang chos kyi rgya (2ba4)mtsho'i gtam 'dis kyang*// sngags rlom khron par skyes rnams snying 'gas pas// bdag la sdig 'gyur tshig 'di khyod kho nas// nyan nas bags kyis gzhan la bsnyad par 'os// 'di ni la stod byang nas chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis stobs rgyas kyis zla gsar cho ga la brten pa'i dri tshig cung zad mdzad pa'i lan du/

sngags 'chang pad+ma dkar pos bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i dmag gi sde'i dbus/ thub bstan lang tsho bdo ba'i thang*/ dpal byams pa chen po chos kyi gling gi gtsug lag khang nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ/ chos yin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
